formal_statements.role: Universal physical formulation for arbitrary isometric tensor and PRV realizations satisfying literal intertwining equations.
formal_statements.compiled_statement:
∀ {d r : ℕ} (s : FreeEntropy.FixedSpectrum d r) (hd : 2 ≤ d) (mu nu : Fin d → ℕ),
  Antitone mu →
    Antitone nu →
      (∀ (i : Fin d), r ≤ ↑i → mu i = 0) →
        (∀ (i : Fin d), r ≤ ↑i → nu i = 0) →
          (Antitone fun (i : Fin d) => ↑(nu i) - ↑(mu i)) →
            ∀ (Jmu : Matrix (Fin (∑ j : Fin d, mu j) → Fin d) (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.IrrepIndex mu) ℂ)
              (Jnu : Matrix (Fin (∑ j : Fin d, nu j) → Fin d) (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.IrrepIndex nu) ℂ),
              Jmu.conjTranspose * Jmu = 1 →
                Jnu.conjTranspose * Jnu = 1 →
                  (∀ (V : ↥(Matrix.unitaryGroup (Fin d) ℂ)),
                      (Matrix.of fun (x y : Fin (∑ j : Fin d, mu j) → Fin d) =>
                            ∏ t : Fin (∑ j : Fin d, mu j), ↑V (x t) (y t)) *
                          Jmu =
                        Jmu * (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.canonicalWeightRepresentation mu) V) →
                    (∀ (V : ↥(Matrix.unitaryGroup (Fin d) ℂ)),
                        (Matrix.of fun (x y : Fin (∑ j : Fin d, nu j) → Fin d) =>
                              ∏ t : Fin (∑ j : Fin d, nu j), ↑V (x t) (y t)) *
                            Jnu =
                          Jnu * (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.canonicalWeightRepresentation nu) V) →
                      ∀
                        (Wf :
                          Matrix
                            (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.IrrepIndex mu ×
                              FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.IrrepIndex nu)
                            (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.IrrepIndex
                              (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.auxiliaryRow mu nu))
                            ℂ)
                        (Wr :
                          Matrix
                            (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.IrrepIndex nu ×
                              FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.IrrepIndex mu)
                            (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.IrrepIndex
                              (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.auxiliaryRow mu nu))
                            ℂ),
                        Wf.conjTranspose * Wf = 1 →
                          Wr.conjTranspose * Wr = 1 →
                            (∀ (i j : Fin d),
                                ((FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.canonicalWeightModel mu).generators.dual.tensor
                                          (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.canonicalWeightModel nu).generators).E
                                      i j *
                                    Wf =
                                  Wf *
                                    (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.canonicalAuxiliaryModel mu nu).generators.E i
                                      j) →
                              (∀ (i j : Fin d),
                                  ((FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.canonicalWeightModel nu).generators.dual.tensor
                                            (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.canonicalWeightModel mu).generators).E
                                        i j *
                                      Wr =
                                    Wr *
                                      (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.canonicalAuxiliaryModel mu
                                                nu).generators.dual.E
                                        i j) →
                                ∀ (U : ↥(Matrix.unitaryGroup (Fin d) ℂ)),
                                  FreeEntropy.TraceDistance.traceDistance
                                        (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.physicalPrvMap Wf
                                          (FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.physicalIsometricState (∑ j : Fin d, mu j) Jmu
                                            (FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.physicalSpectrumDensity s U)))
                                        (FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.physicalIsometricState (∑ j : Fin d, nu j) Jnu
                                          (FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.physicalSpectrumDensity s U)) ≤
                                      FreeEntropy.Theorem2.cloningConstant d r s.qx *
                                          ↑(FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.differenceNorm mu nu) /
                                        (↑(FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.minimumRowGap mu r hd ⋯) + 1) ∧
                                    FreeEntropy.TraceDistance.traceDistance
                                        (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.physicalPrvMap Wr
                                          (FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.physicalIsometricState (∑ j : Fin d, nu j) Jnu
                                            (FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.physicalSpectrumDensity s U)))
                                        (FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.physicalIsometricState (∑ j : Fin d, mu j) Jmu
                                          (FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.physicalSpectrumDensity s U)) ≤
                                      FreeEntropy.Theorem2.cloningConstant d r s.qx *
                                          ↑(FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.differenceNorm mu nu) /
                                        (↑(FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.minimumRowGap mu r hd ⋯) + 1)

∀ {d : ℕ} (mu nu : Fin d → ℕ),
  Antitone mu →
    Antitone nu →
      (Antitone fun (i : Fin d) => ↑(nu i) - ↑(mu i)) →
        ∃ (Jmu : Matrix (Fin (∑ j : Fin d, mu j) → Fin d) (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.IrrepIndex mu) ℂ) (Jnu :
          Matrix (Fin (∑ j : Fin d, nu j) → Fin d) (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.IrrepIndex nu) ℂ) (Wf :
          Matrix (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.IrrepIndex mu × FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.IrrepIndex nu)
            (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.IrrepIndex (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.auxiliaryRow mu nu)) ℂ)
          (Wr :
          Matrix (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.IrrepIndex nu × FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.IrrepIndex mu)
            (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.IrrepIndex (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.auxiliaryRow mu nu)) ℂ),
          Jmu.conjTranspose * Jmu = 1 ∧
            Jnu.conjTranspose * Jnu = 1 ∧
              (∀ (V : ↥(Matrix.unitaryGroup (Fin d) ℂ)),
                  (Matrix.of fun (x y : Fin (∑ j : Fin d, mu j) → Fin d) =>
                        ∏ t : Fin (∑ j : Fin d, mu j), ↑V (x t) (y t)) *
                      Jmu =
                    Jmu * (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.canonicalWeightRepresentation mu) V) ∧
                (∀ (V : ↥(Matrix.unitaryGroup (Fin d) ℂ)),
                    (Matrix.of fun (x y : Fin (∑ j : Fin d, nu j) → Fin d) =>
                          ∏ t : Fin (∑ j : Fin d, nu j), ↑V (x t) (y t)) *
                        Jnu =
                      Jnu * (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.canonicalWeightRepresentation nu) V) ∧
                  Wf.conjTranspose * Wf = 1 ∧
                    Wr.conjTranspose * Wr = 1 ∧
                      (∀ (i j : Fin d),
                          ((FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.canonicalWeightModel mu).generators.dual.tensor
                                    (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.canonicalWeightModel nu).generators).E
                                i j *
                              Wf =
                            Wf * (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.canonicalAuxiliaryModel mu nu).generators.E i j) ∧
                        ∀ (i j : Fin d),
                          ((FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.canonicalWeightModel nu).generators.dual.tensor
                                    (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.canonicalWeightModel mu).generators).E
                                i j *
                              Wr =
                            Wr *
                              (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.canonicalAuxiliaryModel mu nu).generators.dual.E i j

interface_hypotheses.meaning: Isometric inclusions from canonical irrep coordinates to physical tensor space, with exactly the U(d) tensor-action equations. They are arbitrary; existence is separately proved.

Isometric copies of the forward auxiliary and reverse dual auxiliary modules. Generator intertwining is stated directly; no equality to a constructed projector or supplied multiplicity assumption occurs.

limitations: State and projector realization choices are independently specified, but the lower representation coordinates, generators and numerical definitions remain shared. This is not an independent reconstruction of representation theory or a human correspondence review.
